QXRobGV0aWNz.name: Athletics
QXRobGV0aWNz.description: Moving your body under pressure: sprinting, vaulting, climbing, swimming the bayou, diving behind cover.
QXRobGV0aWNz.overcome: Cross a zone with a terrain aspect (Deep Water, Mud, Barbed Fence), climb a roof, outrun a pursuer.
QXRobGV0aWNz.caa: Reach high ground, slide into cover, get a head start.
QXRobGV0aWNz.defend: The default defence against shots, blows and blasts when you know they are coming.

QnVyZ2xhcnk.name: Burglary
QnVyZ2xhcnk.description: Getting into places that are locked, chained or trapped, and taking what is inside.
QnVyZ2xhcnk.overcome: Pick a lock, bypass a chained door, disarm a tripwire or bear trap, loot quietly.
QnVyZ2xhcnk.caa: Case a compound for weak points and hidden ways in.

Q3JhZnRz.name: Crafts
Q3JhZnRz.description: Working with mechanisms: guns, traps, tools, explosives.
Q3JhZnRz.overcome: Clear a jammed weapon (Fair +2), repair gear, rig a trap or a fuse.
Q3JhZnRz.caa: Rig an improvised obstacle, sabotage a rival's gear, set up a booby trap.
Q3JhZnRz.attack: Not usually an attack skill (traps use it to set the difficulty).

RGVjZWl2ZQ.name: Deceive
RGVjZWl2ZQ.description: Lying, bluffing and misdirection, against rival hunters as much as anyone.
RGVjZWl2ZQ.overcome: Bluff a rival team into believing you are friendly, or that you already left.
RGVjZWl2ZQ.caa: Fake a retreat, plant a false trail, feint.
RGVjZWl2ZQ.defend: Defend against Empathy reads of your true intent.

RW1wYXRoeQ.name: Empathy
RW1wYXRoeQ.description: Reading people: intent, fear, the moment someone is about to betray a truce.
RW1wYXRoeQ.overcome: Spot a lie or a shift in a rival's attitude.
RW1wYXRoeQ.caa: Discover a hunter's aspect, read their breaking point.
RW1wYXRoeQ.defend: Defend against Deceive. A Field Medic uses it to calm an ally's Dread.

RmlnaHQ.name: Fight
RmlnaHQ.description: Melee combat: knives, machetes, axes, sledgehammers, fists, rifle butts.
RmlnaHQ.caa: Trip, disarm, shove someone off a ledge.
RmlnaHQ.attack: Melee attacks, same zone only. Weapon power is added on a hit.

SGVhbA.name: Heal
SGVhbA.description: Field medicine: bandages, first aid kits, stitching wounds under fire.
SGVhbA.overcome: Use a first aid kit (Fair +2): success clears 2 Health boxes, +1 per extra shift.
SGVhbA.caa: Stabilise a downed hunter, prepare a wound for treatment.

SW52ZXN0aWdhdGU.name: Investigate
SW52ZXN0aWdhdGU.description: Methodical search: clues, tracks, the Bounty's trail.
SW52ZXN0aWdhdGU.overcome: Search a building for a clue, follow a blood trail, read a ritual site.
SW52ZXN0aWdhdGU.caa: Uncover details of a compound, a trail, a past fight.

TG9yZQ.name: Lore
TG9yZQ.description: Knowledge of the occult, the Hive, the Bounties and the old ways of the bayou.
TG9yZQ.overcome: Identify a monster, a ritual, a cursed object.
TG9yZQ.caa: Reveal a monster's weakness or behaviour.

Tm90aWNl.name: Notice
Tm90aWNl.description: Alertness: the crow that takes off, the creak on the stairs, the glint of a scope.
Tm90aWNl.overcome: Hear or spot something before it is too late.
Tm90aWNl.caa: Spot an escape route, a sniper's nest, a weak point.
Tm90aWNl.defend: Defend against Stealth. Sets turn order in an exchange.

UGh5c2lxdWU.name: Physique
UGh5c2lxdWU.overcome: Force a door, carry a downed partner, endure poison or fire.
UGh5c2lxdWU.defend: Block a doorway against someone forcing their way through. At Great (+4), grants a second Mild consequence.

UHJvdm9rZQ.name: Provoke
UHJvdm9rZQ.description: Intimidation and taunts: getting a rival to break cover or a nerve to snap.
UHJvdm9rZQ.overcome: Scare off a rival, bait a team into rushing you.
UHJvdm9rZQ.caa: Make someone Rattled, Enraged or Hesitant.
UHJvdm9rZQ.defend: Not a defence skill. Use Will.

UmFwcG9ydA.name: Rapport
UmFwcG9ydA.description: Trust and goodwill, enough to make a truce hold for one more minute.
UmFwcG9ydA.overcome: Negotiate a truce, talk a rival into sharing the extraction.
UmFwcG9ydA.caa: Create a mood of trust, make a rival Talkative.
UmFwcG9ydA.defend: Defend against attempts to turn others against you.

UmVzb3VyY2Vz.name: Resources
UmVzb3VyY2Vz.description: What you have on you, what you can find, and what you can afford.
UmVzb3VyY2Vz.overcome: Turn up the right supply, find extra ammunition in a crate.
UmVzb3VyY2Vz.caa: Declare you carry the right tool or consumable.

U2hvb3Q.name: Shoot
U2hvb3Q.caa: Suppressing fire, Pinning a target, shooting out a lantern.
U2hvb3Q.attack: Ranged attacks within the weapon's range bands. Weapon power is added on a hit.

U3RlYWx0aA.name: Stealth
U3RlYWx0aA.description: Moving unseen and unheard: crouching through reeds, avoiding crows, chickens and broken glass.
U3RlYWx0aA.overcome: Cross a zone unnoticed, slip past a patrol of Grunts.
U3RlYWx0aA.caa: Become Hidden, set up an ambush.
U3RlYWx0aA.defend: Defend against Notice attempts to find you.

VGhyb3c.name: Throw
VGhyb3c.description: Throwing knives, axes, dynamite, bombs and anything else that leaves your hand.
VGhyb3c.overcome: Land a throw in a specific spot.
VGhyb3c.caa: Create a zone aspect with a bomb (Razor Wire, Choking Smoke, Burning Ground).
VGhyb3c.attack: Thrown weapon attacks; explosives target a zone (see the combat rules).

V2lsbA.name: Will
V2lsbA.description: Nerve and resolve against the horrors of the bayou.
V2lsbA.overcome: Hold your nerve, resist the Hive's whispers, recover from Dread after a fight (Fair +2).
V2lsbA.caa: Focus: steady yourself before a decisive shot.
V2lsbA.defend: Defend against Provoke and against a monster's dread rating.

SGVhbHRo.name: Health
SGVhbHRo.description: Three chunks of two boxes (1-2, 3-4, 5-6). Each box absorbs 1 damage.
SGVhbHRo.when_marked: When you take damage, mark one box per point of damage that you don't absorb with a consequence. Fire damage burns boxes instead (see Burned).
SGVhbHRo.recovery_conditions: Bandage (action): clear 1 box. First aid kit (action, Heal vs Fair): clear 2 boxes, +1 per extra shift. When revived, all marked boxes clear but one chunk is Burned.
SGVhbHRo.label: none

QnVybmVk.name: Burned
QnVybmVk.description: One box per Health chunk lost for the rest of the mission. Each burned chunk strikes out two Health boxes.
QnVybmVk.when_marked: When you are revived, or when fire burns through a whole chunk.
QnVybmVk.recovery_conditions: Only at the end of the mission. Three burned chunks: the hunter is dead.
QnVybmVk.label: none

RHJlYWQ.name: Dread
RHJlYWQ.when_marked: When a monster hits you, roll Will against its dread rating (Grunt +1, Hive/Armored +2, Butcher/Spider/Assassin +4). On a failure, mark one box. With all 3 marked, mark the Shaken condition.
RHJlYWQ.recovery_conditions: After each skirmish, Will vs Fair (+2): success clears 1 box, success with style clears all. A Field Medic can clear 1 box with Empathy vs Fair as an action.
RHJlYWQ.label: none

TWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.name: Mild Consequence
TWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.description: Absorbs 2 damage. Examples: Grazed Arm, Ringing Ears, Twisted Ankle.
TWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.recovery_conditions: Clears at the end of the scene if it was bandaged.
TWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.label: none

UGh5c2ljYWwgTWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.name: Physical Mild Consequence
UGh5c2ljYWwgTWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.description: An extra Mild consequence for hunters with Physique Great (+4).
UGh5c2ljYWwgTWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.recovery_conditions: Clears at the end of the scene if it was bandaged.
UGh5c2ljYWwgTWlsZCBDb25zZXF1ZW5jZQ.label: none

TW9kZXJhdGUgQ29uc2VxdWVuY2U.name: Moderate Consequence
TW9kZXJhdGUgQ29uc2VxdWVuY2U.description: Absorbs 4 damage. Examples: Gut Shot, Shattered Wrist, Deep Burns.
TW9kZXJhdGUgQ29uc2VxdWVuY2U.recovery_conditions: Never heals during a mission. Field Surgery (Field Medic, once per mission) downgrades it to Mild.
TW9kZXJhdGUgQ29uc2VxdWVuY2U.label: none

U2V2ZXJlIENvbnNlcXVlbmNl.name: Severe Consequence
U2V2ZXJlIENvbnNlcXVlbmNl.description: Absorbs 6 damage. Examples: Lung Shot, Leg Torn Open, Half-Blind.
U2V2ZXJlIENvbnNlcXVlbmNl.recovery_conditions: Never heals during a mission. Field Surgery (Field Medic, once per mission) downgrades it to Moderate.
U2V2ZXJlIENvbnNlcXVlbmNl.label: none

QmxlZWRpbmc.name: Bleeding
QmxlZWRpbmc.description: 1 damage at the end of each exchange. A new hit while Bleeding turns it into Heavy Bleeding. Stopped by a first aid kit.
QmxlZWRpbmc.when_marked: On a Vital ballistic die result, or a hit from a frag or concertina bomb.
QmxlZWRpbmc.recovery_conditions: One bandage. Bloodless prevents the escalation to Heavy Bleeding.
QmxlZWRpbmc.label: none

SGVhdnkgQmxlZWRpbmc.name: Heavy Bleeding
SGVhdnkgQmxlZWRpbmc.description: 2 damage at the end of each exchange.
SGVhdnkgQmxlZWRpbmc.when_marked: When a Bleeding hunter takes a new hit.
SGVhdnkgQmxlZWRpbmc.recovery_conditions: Two bandages, or one first aid kit.
SGVhdnkgQmxlZWRpbmc.label: none

QnVybmluZw.name: Burning
QnVybmluZw.description: Burns 1 Health box at the end of each exchange; if that empties a chunk, the chunk burns away (Burned). −2 to Stealth. Putting it out: Athletics overcome vs Fair (+2), or water, or choke smoke.
QnVybmluZw.when_marked: Incendiary ammo hit, fire bomb, burning ground, Immolator.
QnVybmluZw.recovery_conditions: An action to put it out, or entering Deep Water.
QnVybmluZw.label: none

UG9pc29uZWQ.name: Poisoned
UG9pc29uZWQ.description: 1 damage at the end of each exchange and −1 to all rolls. Health boxes cannot be cleared. Cured by an antidote.
UG9pc29uZWQ.when_marked: Poison ammo hit, poison bomb, Spider.
UG9pc29uZWQ.recovery_conditions: End of the scene (Mithridatist: end of the exchange).
UG9pc29uZWQ.label: none

UGlubmVk.name: Pinned
UGlubmVk.description: −2 to your next attack. Leaving cover is an Athletics overcome at Fair (+2).
UGlubmVk.when_marked: When an attack against you ties.
UGlubmVk.label: none

QmxpbmRlZA.name: Blinded
QmxpbmRlZA.description: −2 to Shoot, Notice and Throw. No Dark Sight.
QmxpbmRlZA.when_marked: Flash, choke smoke in the eyes, mud.
QmxpbmRlZA.label: none

U2hha2Vu.name: Shaken
U2hha2Vu.description: −1 to Shoot, Throw and defence rolls (Athletics, Will).
U2hha2Vu.when_marked: When all three Dread boxes are marked.
U2hha2Vu.recovery_conditions: When a Dread box is cleared.
U2hha2Vu.label: none

RG93bmVk.name: Downed
RG93bmVk.description: No action, no move. You can still talk.
RG93bmVk.when_marked: When you cannot absorb a hit.
RG93bmVk.recovery_conditions: A teammate in your zone revives you (action, no roll). Revival burns one chunk. A downed hunter who catches fire burns one chunk per exchange.
RG93bmVk.label: none

SGlnaCBDb25jZXB0.name: High Concept
SGlnaCBDb25jZXB0.description: Who your hunter is, in one line. Example: Disgraced Pinkerton With a Steady Hand.

VHJvdWJsZQ.name: Trouble
VHJvdWJsZQ.description: What complicates your hunter's life. Example: Owes the Wrong People in New Orleans.

QXJjaGV0eXBl.name: Archetype
QXJjaGV0eXBl.description: Your archetype, phrased as an aspect. Example: Sapper Who Cooks the Fuse Too Long.

Qmxvb2RsaW5l.name: Bloodline
Qmxvb2RsaW5l.description: Where your hunter comes from, or who they hunt for. Example: Last of the Duchamp Line.

UGF0aGZpbmRlciAoU2NvdXQp.name: Pathfinder (Scout)
UGF0aGZpbmRlciAoU2NvdXQp.description: Once per scene, create the aspect Marked on a target or a zone you can see, with one free invoke your allies can use.

VW5icmVha2FibGUgKEJydXRlKQ.name: Unbreakable (Brute)
VW5icmVha2FibGUgKEJydXRlKQ.description: You have an extra Mild consequence that can only absorb melee damage.

UXVpY2sgRHJhdyAoR3Vuc2xpbmdlcik.name: Quick Draw (Gunslinger)
UXVpY2sgRHJhdyAoR3Vuc2xpbmdlcik.description: In the first exchange of a fight, you act before everyone else. Once per scene, one extra-shot die does not add weapon stress on a −.

RmllbGQgU3VyZ2VyeSAoRmllbGQgTWVkaWMp.name: Field Surgery (Field Medic)
RmllbGQgU3VyZ2VyeSAoRmllbGQgTWVkaWMp.description: Once per mission, as an action, downgrade one consequence by one step (Severe → Moderate, Moderate → Mild).

QXR0dW5lZCAoTXlzdGljKQ.name: Attuned (Mystic)
QXR0dW5lZCAoTXlzdGljKQ.description: In Dark Sight, you sense the zone of the nearest Clue or the Bounty. +2 to rolls against the supernatural.

UGFjayBSYXQgKFNjYXZlbmdlcik.name: Pack Rat (Scavenger)
UGFjayBSYXQgKFNjYXZlbmdlcik.description: When you search a crate or a body, roll Resources. Each + on the dice finds one extra item.

Q29va2VkIEZ1c2UgKFNhcHBlcik.name: Cooked Fuse (Sapper)
Q29va2VkIEZ1c2UgKFNhcHBlcik.description: Your explosives go off when you choose: at once, or at the end of the exchange. You never take damage from your own explosions.
